content.text:
Confirmed the full chain in `guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java` (Segment class).

On a cache read, `Segment.get` finds a live entry and, after recording the hit, calls `scheduleRefresh`, which checks `map.refreshes()` and whether the entry's write time exceeds `refreshNanos`; if so it calls `refresh`, which calls `insertLoadingValueReference` (installs a `LoadingValueReference` under the segment lock so only one thread refreshes) then `loadAsync` (kicks off `CacheLoader.reload`/future). When that future completes, its listener invokes `getAndRecordStats`, which calls `storeLoadedValue` to install the new value into the segment (or, on failure/null, `removeLoadingValue` instead).

ANSWER: Segment.get → Segment.scheduleRefresh → Segment.refresh → Segment.insertLoadingValueReference → Segment.loadAsync → (future completion) Segment.getAndRecordStats → Segment.storeLoadedValue
